# ChorusSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ChorusSoundEffect")`

Adds a copy of the sound that drifts slightly out of time and tune with it, which makes one voice sound like several.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Depth` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How far the copy drifts, from 0 to 1. |
| `Mix` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How much of the output is the copy, from 0 to 1. |
| `Rate` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The speed at which the copy drifts back and forth, in hertz. |
